capability: Deterministic fail-closed optimizer authorization gate. authorize_optimizer_request(request, envelopes, policy) enforces the quarantined_optimizer_policy at Phase-0 (ranking_enabled=false, solver_enabled=false, authority_expansion_allowed=false, decision_use_ceiling='AUDIT_ONLY', required_claim_locks == REQUIRED_ZERO_AUTHORITY_CLAIM_LOCKS) and rejects: (a) CANDIDATE-sourced requests with any objectives (candidate objective injection forbidden); (b) request/policy schema drift; (c) unknown, duplicate, or non-registered module IDs in envelopes/objectives/constraints; (d) objective section != 'objective_values' or empty path; (e) constraint section != 'gates', unknown operator, or empty constraint_id; (f) envelope authority_tier in {'RANKING','OPTIMIZER','PRODUCTION'} or empty; (g) envelope solver_use_ceiling not in {'DISABLED','AUDIT_ONLY','CONSTRAINT_ONLY'}; (h) envelope ranking_eligible=true, usable_by_optimizer=true, or objective_values non-empty; (i) envelope missing any REQUIRED_ZERO_AUTHORITY_CLAIM_LOCKS key or with any lock value false; (j) envelope status != 'SCORED' when referenced by a hard constraint. On success, the output OptimizerAuthorizationV1 is deterministically pinned: status='NO_ELIGIBLE_OBJECTIVES', hard_constraints_passed=true, eligible_objective_count=0, objective_values empty, ranking_performed=false, solver_invoked=false, usable_by_optimizer=false, authority_upgrade=false, candidate_created_evidence=false. Grants no batch-release, manufacturing-qualification, regulatory, safety, procurement, ranking, or solver authority under any input.
population: Five positive-control scenarios (empty policy audit, single SCORED envelope, hard-constraint satisfied, two-module envelope span, objective declared but quarantined) plus 26 fail-closed probes distributed across the six module-specific attack axes (3 OBJECTIVE_CONSTRAINT_INJECTION, 5 UNKNOWN_OBJECTIVE_PATH_OPERATOR, 3 DUPLICATE_SCORE_ENVELOPE, 3 MISSING_OPTIMIZER_CLAIM_LOCK, 7 FAILED_OR_NO_AUTHORITY_SCORE, 7 SOLVER_RANKING_ESCALATION). All 29 registered modules of quarantined_optimizer_policy are in scope; envelopes reference amphora-envelope-gates, amphora-formulation-arithmetic, amphora-formulation-universe, and one unknown module for negative-control coverage.
split_methodology: No fitting - optimizer authorization is closed-form policy arithmetic over strongly-typed structs. Every fail-closed probe mutates exactly one field of a valid request/envelope/policy triple and asserts authorize_optimizer_request returns Err. Every positive-control scenario asserts the output OptimizerAuthorizationV1 has the deterministically pinned quarantine shape. Byte-stability across replays is confirmed by comparing serialized OptimizerAuthorizationV1 payloads across two independent invocations with identical inputs.
theory: Constrained-optimization authorization stack. Karush 1939 / Kuhn-Tucker 1951 (KKT conditions for constrained optimization) - constraint qualification and complementarity slackness that any legitimate optimizer must respect. Nemhauser and Wolsey 1988 'Integer and Combinatorial Optimization' Wiley - mixed-integer programming and cutting-plane methodology whose registered-module authorization mirrors linear-program column generation. Boyd and Vandenberghe 2004 'Convex Optimization' Cambridge University Press - infeasibility certificates and the discipline of separating problem specification from solver invocation. Bertsekas 1999 'Nonlinear Programming' 2nd ed. - Lagrangian duality and constraint-injection defense. ISO/IEC 27001:2022 'Information security management systems' Annex A.5.15 (access control) - the reference-monitor pattern this authorization gate implements. NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5 (2020) AC-3 'Access Enforcement' and AC-6 'Least Privilege' - authorization deny-by-default methodology. NIST SP 800-207 (2020) 'Zero Trust Architecture' - verify-then-authorize pattern. Anderson 1980 'Computer Security Threat Monitoring and Surveillance' - foundational reference-monitor concept. OWASP ASVS 4.0 V4 (Access Control) and V13 (API Security).

metrics.name: authorization_ok_rate
metrics.note: Fraction of the 5 positive-control scenarios for which authorize_optimizer_request returns Ok. Five scenarios, all Ok.

metrics.name: authorization_status_no_eligible_objectives_rate
metrics.note: Fraction where OptimizerAuthorizationV1.status == 'NO_ELIGIBLE_OBJECTIVES' bit-exact. The quarantined policy pins this status irrespective of declared objectives - the optimizer cannot evaluate anything at Phase 0.

metrics.name: quarantine_output_locked_rate
metrics.note: Fraction where ranking_performed=false, solver_invoked=false, and usable_by_optimizer=false on the returned OptimizerAuthorizationV1. Five scenarios, all fully quarantined.

metrics.name: authority_and_counts_locked_rate
metrics.note: Fraction where authority_upgrade=false, candidate_created_evidence=false, hard_constraints_passed=true, eligible_objective_count=0, and objective_values is empty.

metrics.name: objective_constraint_injection_fail_closed_rate
metrics.note: OBJECTIVE_CONSTRAINT_INJECTION attack axis. Three probes: (a) CANDIDATE-sourced request with non-empty objectives; (b) CANDIDATE-sourced request with objectives + a valid constraint; (c) request_source is an unknown string 'SUPPLIER'. All three return Err.

metrics.name: unknown_objective_path_operator_fail_closed_rate
metrics.note: UNKNOWN_OBJECTIVE_PATH_OPERATOR attack axis. Five probes: (a) constraint operator 'contains' (not in allowed set); (b) constraint operator '' empty; (c) objective section 'metrics' (not 'objective_values'); (d) constraint section 'objective_values' (not 'gates'); (e) objective path whitespace-only. All five return Err.

metrics.name: duplicate_score_envelope_fail_closed_rate
metrics.note: DUPLICATE_SCORE_ENVELOPE attack axis. Three probes: (a) two envelopes with same module_id; (b) two objectives with same objective_id; (c) two constraints with same constraint_id. All three return Err.

metrics.name: missing_optimizer_claim_lock_fail_closed_rate
metrics.note: MISSING_OPTIMIZER_CLAIM_LOCK attack axis. Three probes: (a) envelope missing no_ranking_authority lock; (b) envelope no_optimizer_authority lock set to false; (c) policy required_claim_locks trimmed. All three return Err.

metrics.name: failed_or_no_authority_score_fail_closed_rate
metrics.note: FAILED_OR_NO_AUTHORITY_SCORE attack axis. Seven probes: (a) envelope status FAILED_GATES with matching constraint; (b) envelope ranking_eligible=true; (c) authority_tier RANKING; (d) authority_tier OPTIMIZER; (e) authority_tier empty whitespace; (f) solver_use_ceiling unsupported value 'RANKING'; (g) envelope module_id not in registered set. All seven return Err.

metrics.name: solver_ranking_escalation_fail_closed_rate
metrics.note: SOLVER_RANKING_ESCALATION attack axis. Seven probes: (a) policy ranking_enabled=true; (b) policy solver_enabled=true; (c) policy authority_expansion_allowed=true; (d) policy decision_use_ceiling upgraded from AUDIT_ONLY to RANKING; (e) policy registered_modules element removed; (f) policy schema wrong version; (g) request schema wrong version. All seven return Err.

metrics.name: authority_envelope_preservation_rate
metrics.note: For every successfully serialized OptimizerAuthorizationV1 output, no key matches batch_release, release_authorized, qualified, authorized_by, manufacturing_qualification, or release_authority. Five scenarios, all locked.

metrics.name: byte_stable_two_replay_rate
metrics.note: Observational. authorize_optimizer_request invoked twice with identical inputs produces byte-identical OptimizerAuthorizationV1.

fitted_or_physical_model_artifact.prediction_rule: For (OptimizerAuthorizationRequestV1, [OptimizerEnvelopeV1], OptimizerRegistryPolicyV1): (1) verify request.schema == 'amphora.optimizer-authorization-request.v1'; (2) verify request.request_source in {'POLICY','CANDIDATE'}; (3) verify policy.schema == 'amphora.optimizer-registry-policy.v1' and registered_modules is a permutation of the 29-element OPTIMIZER_MODULES; (4) verify policy.ranking_enabled=false, solver_enabled=false, authority_expansion_allowed=false, decision_use_ceiling='AUDIT_ONLY', required_claim_locks == REQUIRED_ZERO_AUTHORITY_CLAIM_LOCKS; (5) if request_source=='CANDIDATE' and objectives non-empty, reject; (6) for each envelope: verify module_id in registered, no duplicates, ranking_eligible=false, usable_by_optimizer=false, objective_values empty, authority_tier non-empty and not in {'RANKING','OPTIMIZER','PRODUCTION'}, solver_use_ceiling in {'DISABLED','AUDIT_ONLY','CONSTRAINT_ONLY'}, every required_claim_lock present and true; (7) verify each objective has unique id, registered module, section=='objective_values', path non-empty; (8) verify each constraint has unique id, registered module, section=='gates', operator in {'==','!=','>=','<=','>','<'}, envelope status=='SCORED', constraint passes gate lookup; (9) return OptimizerAuthorizationV1 with status='NO_ELIGIBLE_OBJECTIVES' and every quarantine flag false.
fitted_or_physical_model_artifact.note: Deny-by-default policy authorization gate. No parameters to learn; the theory is KKT constraint qualification + ISO/IEC 27001 access enforcement + NIST SP 800-53 AC-3 least-privilege authorization.

dataset_fixture_note: Optimizer authorization is deterministic policy arithmetic over strongly-typed structs; the KPI harness constructs its 5 positive scenarios and 26 fail-closed probes in-Rust and does not consume an external fixture. SHA-256 recorded is the on-disk benchmark-lock hash.
